steps.domain_action: Initialize the system in the Deep, the unmarked state before any conditional logic exists.
Establish the identity of the 'if' primitive as the self-written cut 𐑦.
The 'if' primitive splits the execution stream into two potential paths based on the condition.
Evaluate the condition on the T-arm; if true, the forward morphism AFWD is activated.
Execute the logic of the affirmative branch, moving the system forward along the established path.
Evaluate the condition on the F-arm; if false, the reverse morphism AREV is activated.
Execute the logic of the negative branch, moving the system along the alternative path.
If the condition is paradoxical, hold both T and F states simultaneously without resolving the contradiction.
Rejoin the T and F arms into a single control flow, fusing the results of the divergent paths.
Compose the resolved conditional block with the subsequent operations in the sequence.
Record the decision and the resulting state in the permanent execution trace.
Anchor the completed conditional structure within the boundary of the Wyrding Loom.
